REPORT zreg_field_symbols.

INCLUDE zreg_field_symbols_top.

CLASS lcl_reader DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS current_qty RETURNING VALUE(rv_qty) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD current_qty.
    rv_qty = <gs_prod_ord_list>-qty.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

DATA go_reader TYPE REF TO lcl_reader.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  " A generic field symbol is an alias: writing it writes the global.
  ASSIGN gv_text TO <lv_data>.
  <lv_data> = 'through data'.
  WRITE / gv_text.

  " Bound in a FORM, used here and in a local class; the FORM's sy-subrc
  " survives taking the binding over.
  gt_prod_ord_list = VALUE #( ( id = 1 qty = 10 ) ( id = 2 qty = 20 ) ).
  PERFORM bind_order.
  gv_subrc = sy-subrc.
  WRITE / gv_subrc.
  <gs_prod_ord_list>-qty = 25.
  READ TABLE gt_prod_ord_list INTO gs_order INDEX 2.
  WRITE / gs_order-qty.
  go_reader = NEW #( ).
  gv_count = go_reader->current_qty( ).
  WRITE / gv_count.

  " Generic table field symbols.
  ASSIGN gt_prod_ord_list TO <gt_itab>.
  LOOP AT <gt_itab> ASSIGNING <struc>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'QTY' OF STRUCTURE <struc> TO <lv_field>.
    <lv_field> = <lv_field> + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  ASSIGN gt_prod_ord_list TO <gt_table>.
  gv_count = lines( <gt_table> ).
  WRITE / gv_count.
  READ TABLE gt_prod_ord_list INTO gs_order INDEX 1.
  WRITE / gs_order-qty.

  PERFORM pick_list.
  PERFORM dynamic_into.

  " A dynamic table built, filled and read in three FORMs.
  PERFORM build_dynamic.
  PERFORM fill_dynamic.
  PERFORM show_dynamic.
  ASSIGN gr_table->* TO <lt_data>.
  ASSIGN <lt_data> TO <gt_alv_dyn_table>.
  gv_count = lines( <gt_alv_dyn_table> ).
  WRITE / gv_count.

  PERFORM release_order.
  IF <gs_prod_ord_list> IS ASSIGNED.
    WRITE / 'assigned'.
  ELSE.
    WRITE / 'unassigned'.
  ENDIF.

INCLUDE zreg_field_symbols_forms.
